The weighted cloud reliability calculator passed all tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a functional core logic for risk assessment.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and record_success=True across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.39s. While the mean score is 1.000, the judge_reward of 0.20 suggests that while the code is functional, there may be significant room to improve documentation or edge-case handling.
